description: Runs a compliance risk audit on a diarized call transcript, detecting violations and positives, applying the ISO 31000 risk matrix, classifying the conversation into a level and returning the verdict with the applied actions and the NIST/OWASP risk framework enquadramento; use it for compliance and quality audits of company-agent-to-client calls, not for generic conversation summarization. Required fields: dialog (diarized transcript in the format 'Speaker 1: [00:00:00.540 - 00:00:01.139] text', speaker labels accepted in any case as Speaker, Interlocutor, Hablante, Locutor or Orador plus number; plain text is not accepted; max 300,000 characters), duration_seconds (total audio duration in seconds, must be >= the last turn end time) and language plus response_language (only pt-BR, en-US or es-ES). Optional: model (always 'falaai-risk-audit-1'), audio_events (up to 500, each requiring event and start_s), participants (up to 10 with interlocutor and role agent/client/bot, ground truth when provided, else inferred), call_direction (inbound/outbound, inferred when omitted), response_format (only 'v2'), client_reference_id (echoed verbatim, charset [A-Za-z0-9 _/:.-], max 60). Returns response (V2) with meta+usage, participants, verdict with level and applied actions, scores, detections (violations, positives, client alerts), analysis frameworks, timeline, categories_summary, executive summary, scoring explanation and an HTML report (gzip+base64). This call consumes credits and the amount actually charged is returned in response.meta.usage.credits_consumed. Stateless: neither the transcript nor the analysis is persisted (only billing and usage metadata is logged), protecting personal data under LGPD. IMPORTANT: this call charges credits and the result is NOT stored — you MUST read the FULL response and relay ALL of its information to the user (every field, including verdict, scores, detections, timeline and html_report; no omissions, no shortening), and persist it if the user may need it later; calling again charges again.
name: risk_audit
